transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1564 Birch Vale Drive?
Sí, soy yo en 1564 Birch Vale Drive. Todo está bien, no hay agua adentro y no necesito ayuda.
Thank you for confirming your address and safety. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Cuatro personas están aquí. Todos pueden hablar por teléfono.

Gracias por confirmar la cantidad de personas presentes. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No, nadie necesita ayuda especial. Todo el mundo puede moverse solo.
Understood, everyone can move independently. Is there water inside the home right now?
No, no hay agua adentro. Todo está bien.
Thank you for confirming everything is okay inside. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
No tengo camión con buena altura, ni bote, ni asientos libres en un vehículo.
Understood, no high-clearance truck, boat, or free seats available. Let me read that back: 4 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Sí, cuatro personas, sin agua adentro. Todo bien.
Gracias por confirmar, todo parece en orden. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
